title: backlog.py claim is refused in a checkout whose git dir cannot be written, since ledger_lock refuses any OSError, where it claimed without a ledger record before
goal: claim in a checkout whose git dir is not writable claims the item as before the ledger lock, so ledger_lock's OSError on creating the lock file no longer refuses the claim itself; the claim prints a warning that says the claims ledger was not recorded

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
r = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(r), *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init", "-q")
(r / "backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items"}))
(r / "items").mkdir()
item = {"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "t", "status": "todo", "priority": "P3", "goal": "g",
        "touches": ["x.txt"], "checks": [{"run": ["python3", "-c", "pass"]}]}
(r / "items" / "ST-aaaaaaaa.json").write_text(json.dumps(item, indent=2) + "\n")
g("add", "-A")
g("-c", "user.name=x", "-c", "user.email=x@example.com", "commit", "-qm", "i")
gd = Path(g("rev-parse", "--absolute-git-dir"))
mode = gd.stat().st_mode
os.chmod(gd, 0o555)
env = dict(os.environ, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk")
env.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG", None)
try:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py"), "--root", str(r), "claim", "ST-aaaaaaaa",
                        "--by", "w"], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
finally:
    os.chmod(gd, mode)
text = p.stdout + p.stderr
print("claim with an unwritable git dir: exit", p.returncode, "|", text[-300:])
sys.exit(0 if p.returncode == 0 and "not recorded" in text else 1)

clauses.clause: claim in a checkout whose git dir is not writable claims the item as before the ledger lock, so ledger_lock's OSError on creating the lock file no longer refuses the claim itself
the claim prints a warning that says the claims ledger was not recorded
